methods.name: Gaussian mixtures (Full, Tied, Diagonal, Spherical as VVV, EEE, VVI, VII)
methods.reference: mclust::Mclust(G = 3, modelNames = VVV, EEE, VVI, VII); tight fixed points of mclust::mstep/estep
methods.tolerance: EM_PARAM 1e-5 relative, EM_LOGLIK 1e-12 relative (tight fixed points), FIXED_POINT 1e-10 relative from the tight values; df and classification exact. Differences from mclust in the doc: k-means start, relative_change stopping rule (iteration counts not pinned), relative ridge and a warning for a singular covariance where mclust reports NA.

methods.name: Normal and multivariate normal mixture EM
methods.tolerance: EM_PARAM 1e-5 relative, EM_LOGLIK 1e-12 relative (tight fixed points), FIXED_POINT 1e-10 relative from the tight values. Standard EM against normalmixEM's previous-mu sigma update: same fixed point, noted in the doc.

methods.name: Gaussian regression mixtures with minprior
methods.reference: flexmix::flexmix(FLXMRglm(family = "gaussian")); a written-out FLXfit in the case
methods.tolerance: prune 1e-9 relative, keep 1e-7 relative (a borderline stop); log-likelihood 1e-12 and 1e-11; integers exact. Iteration counts and the iteration of a removal are not R-pinned. Exact-fit component: floor and warning where R stops with NaN; the random start uses p2a's RNG, the pins pass the case's start column.
